title: Social vulnerability of the people exposed to wildfires in U.S. West Coast states

idea.research_question: What joint spatial associations are present between wildfire-exposure observations and social-vulnerability population data?
idea.hypothesis: The required components contain a joint signal not represented by any component alone.
idea.mechanism: Align every required component, construct role-specific features, test their joint association, and compare against single-component baselines.
idea.analytical_approach: Multisource spatial-temporal association analysis with robustness and ablation checks
idea.expected_contribution: A benchmark task that requires every component of a composite observation.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject an idea if a required component is absent, background-only, or not operationally used with the other required components.
